### Q122-S3-c01 — FIXED (MAKE-IT-SUCCEED), PINNED (CONFIRMED)

**The source, re-read.** Queue row Q122 (whole): the site spike's S3 class went to M0-c-02 S6; that round's N-59 / N-61
(`checks/M0-c-02-notes.md` lines 1046, 1095) report the siting's share — M0-x-06's Q52 E cell 1918289972 "still refuses
S3 F-WALL 'crosses the core': the slice's stage-1 boundary crosses the plaza reservation (the siting's boundary, OUR OWN
INTERMEDIATE at c-01's step)". Input kind: OUR OWN INTERMEDIATE; verdict MAKE-IT-SUCCEED (N-58).

**The fix, read whole** (`siting/levelset.ts`, `siting/slice.ts`). `levelSet` takes `keepClear` rings; `selectNodes`
adds, after T's selection and the spread over water and before the pocket fill, every interior vertex of a lattice
triangle within `LATTICE.attractCm` + 1 cm of such a ring (`clearNodes`); `keepsSides` refuses a simplify or a Chaikin
pass whose ring does not keep every such ring strictly inside and 26 cm clear (`keepsClear`), falling back to the exact
contour or fewer passes. `s3Slice` passes the lattice's reservations (the main plaza) in `boundaryOf` and in `finish`;
the pick contour is called without it. `gatesOnBoundary` reads `set.selected`, so the gates follow the selection as
cleared. The fix is in this item's files only; T, t₁, the routes' solver and the plaza are untouched.

**The cell through testkit's own door (P2; not the item's test's `runBase`).** `EDGE_FIXTURES`' `cell/bridge×frame`
run at 1918289972 in the own mirror: `handling` `defined`, `problems` [], `tries` 1, `lawful` [], `judgeEdgeOutcome`
null. `edgeChain(1918289972, { blueprint: SMALL_RIVER, upTo: 'S5', registeredS5: true })`: `ran` S1, S3, S4, S5;
`s3.commit` written; the slice's outline meets no plaza side (own exact test), every plaza vertex strictly inside, the
least gap outline – plaza 2 013 cm (contour 1 541 cm), both gates on the outline and the contour, none in the plaza, the
contour encloses exactly the selected nodes (0 of the lattice's nodes on the wrong side), `added` 1 node,
`smoothPasses` 0; **T's own level set at t₁ (the same field, no ring kept clear) meets the plaza on 2 side pairs, gap
0** — the defect, re-derived. The test's blueprint `{ ...RIVER_BLUEPRINT, size: { ..., areaHa: 30 }, walledHa: 6 }`
equals testkit's `SMALL_RIVER` field by field (CITY, aspect 1, 30 ha; relief plain, river from 27 000 cdeg, no mouth;
terrain base; 6 ha walled).
